simple.meaning: מִשְׁחָה (mishchâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “unction (the act); by implication, a consecratory gift.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 26 times across Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, beginning at Exodus 25:6. Its contexts include family line, altar, blood, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁחָה (H4888).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מִשְׁחָה (mishchâh) / H4888 is traced through Exodus 25:6, Exodus 29:7, Exodus 29:21, Exodus 29:29 as a generated source-based concept entry.
